text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I came to the infirmary to have 
<chrname>'s condition checked, when—

Ah, yes, hello~! A custome... I mean, 
a student, right!

An injury? Illness? Or maybe mental care? 
Well, leave ev-er-y-thing to me with a 
boom and a bang!

Huh? Well, since I'm in the infirmary... 
A slightly fantastical school nurse? 
Something like that?

Ahaha, guess I can't fool you. I'll just 
go with introducing myself normally, then.

*Ahem!* Truth be told, I am none other 
than—

The savior who () guides countless 
horsegirls! 
The (self-proclaimed) legendary 
acupuncturist with miraculous hands!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
None other than Sasami Anshinzawa!! 
Wow, so re~assuring☆

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...What a peculiar individual.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wow, looks like you're totally nooot 
re~assured☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, now, now, anyway! 
Intros are out of the way, so ready for a 
good stick?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see. 
It seems communication will be difficult.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! There's no need to be scared, you 
know? 
I'm just gonna poke your secret pressure 
points with my secret bamboo needles.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Then you'll improve by leaps and bounds... 
swell with vigor... 
Basically, it's gonna be suuuuper amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Just so you know, I'm not shady at 
all! 
I've never failed even once!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...My master, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, this is my very first gig, 
so technically speaking, I've never failed 
either!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I spent ten whole years serving 
tea... 
I mean, training under a legendary master!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Wow, rest easy~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no way I could agree to such a 
sketchy proposition. 
I took <chrname> 
and started to leave, but—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, wait, wait, hold on a second!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You're Phalaenopsis, aren't you?! 
The lovely yet valiant warrior princess 
who resolved to fight for her cherished 
garden!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do! I saw you!! 
I'm a fan!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I came here to support you guys! 
To lend you a hand, believe it or not!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
So pleaaase~!! 
Just gimme a chance~!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Your aspiration to inherit your 
master's legacy 
is admirable, but...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Please, please, please! 
I'll even let you choose the pressure 
point!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: I definitely, positively won't fail~!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Probably.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Uh, I mean, a "definitely" that's 
practically "probably"? Kind of? 
...Anyway, don't worry about the little 
details!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, what kind of pressure 
point are we going for?! 
Stat boosts, health boosts... 
I've even got one for boosting charm!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...While it smells terribly dangerous, 
there's a chance—just maybe—that it might 
actually produce incredible results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What should we do...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis

very proud of you.

text_block_list.text: ...Wait, it worked? Seriously?! Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa

I'm a geniuuuus~!!

more.

Well, things like that happen all the

and tilted our heads in bewilderment.
